title: Spring Has Started
body: Your period just ended, estrogen is climbing, and your body is preparing for ovulation. Many people feel a noticeable lift in mood, energy, and motivation right around now. Lean into it.
tip: Schedule the thing you've been putting off. Today is a great day to start.

title: Your Brain on Estrogen
body: Estrogen boosts dopamine and serotonin sensitivity. Translation: clearer thinking, sharper memory, and a brighter mood. Cognitive performance often peaks in mid-to-late follicular phase.
tip: Tackle the mentally demanding task today. Your brain is ready.

title: Schedule Strategy

tip: If you're a planner — look at your calendar. Move important things into this window.

tip: Notice the small cues your body gives. They're real information.

title: Hunger Patterns
body: Estrogen tends to suppress appetite slightly. If you find you're naturally eating less without trying right now — that's normal and it'll shift later in the cycle.
tip: Eat when you're hungry. Don't force, don't restrict. Your body knows.

title: Build the Plan
body: Your follicular brain is great at envisioning, planning, and starting. Save the heavy execution for ovulation and the reflection work for luteal. This week — dream and design.
tip: Write down your goal for the next two weeks. Don't overthink it.
